title: THE SECOND SELF
message: You recognized them before you understood why.
meaning:
The Second Self is recognition without identity.

There is nobody standing before the mirror, yet someone exists inside the reflection. The figure is not presented as another person, a ghost or a future version of you.

The card deliberately refuses to explain the resemblance.

What matters is whether you felt one.
imageAlt: An empty standing mirror reflecting a human figure that is absent from the room
mechanic: Progression RARE. It becomes eligible only after THE MIRROR has been observed three times and THE MASK has appeared, then opens the SECOND_SELF branch.
